<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>RTGA — Refusal in the Trajectory</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Mono:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;1,300&family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,300;0,9..144,400;0,9..144,600;1,9..144,300;1,9..144,400&family=DM+Sans:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..40,300;0,9..40,400;0,9..40,500;1,9..40,300&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  :root {
    --bg: #0a0a0b;
    --bg2: #111115;
    --bg3: #18181d;
    --border: rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    --border2: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    --text: #e8e6e0;
    --muted: #888580;
    --dim: #555250;
    --accent: #c8a96e;
    --accent2: #7b9fd4;
    --accent3: #7dc4a0;
    --red: #e06b6b;
    --serif: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif;
    --mono: 'DM Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;
    --sans: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;
  }

  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

  body {
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.7;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }

  /* ── HERO ── */
  .hero {
    position: relative;
    padding: 100px 0 80px;
    text-align: center;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .hero::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 40% at 50% 0%, rgba(200,169,110,0.08) 0%, transparent 70%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 30% at 80% 60%, rgba(123,159,212,0.05) 0%, transparent 60%);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .hero-eyebrow {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--accent);
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .hero-eyebrow::before, .hero-eyebrow::after {
    content: '';
    width: 32px;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--accent);
    opacity: 0.4;
  }

  h1.title {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 54px);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.18;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    max-width: 820px;
    margin: 0 auto 24px;
    color: #f0ede6;
  }

  h1.title em {
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--accent);
  }

  .hero-sub {
    font-size: 15px;
    color: var(--muted);
    max-width: 560px;
    margin: 0 auto 40px;
    line-height: 1.65;
  }

  .badges {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 48px;
  }

  .badge {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 5px 14px;
    border-radius: 100px;
    border: 1px solid;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  }

  .badge-gold { border-color: rgba(200,169,110,0.35); color: var(--accent); background: rgba(200,169,110,0.06); }
  .badge-blue { border-color: rgba(123,159,212,0.35); color: var(--accent2); background: rgba(123,159,212,0.06); }
  .badge-green { border-color: rgba(125,196,160,0.35); color: var(--accent3); background: rgba(125,196,160,0.06); }
  .badge-red { border-color: rgba(224,107,107,0.35); color: var(--red); background: rgba(224,107,107,0.06); }

  .hero-stats {
    display: inline-grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, auto);
    gap: 0;
    border: 1px solid var(--border2);
    border-radius: 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--bg2);
  }

  .stat {
    padding: 20px 28px;
    border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
    text-align: center;
  }

  .stat:last-child { border-right: none; }

  .stat-val {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 32px;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--accent);
    line-height: 1;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .stat-label {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: var(--dim);
  }

  /* ── LAYOUT ── */
  .container {
    max-width: 900px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 32px;
  }

  section {
    padding: 72px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  section:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

  .section-label {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    color: var(--dim);
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  h2 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: clamp(22px, 3vw, 30px);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.25;
    color: #ece9e2;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }

  h3 {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    color: var(--muted);
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  p { color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 16px; }
  p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

  strong { color: var(--text); font-weight: 500; }

  /* ── ABSTRACT BOX ── */
  .abstract-box {
    border: 1px solid var(--border2);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 32px 36px;
    background: var(--bg2);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .abstract-box::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    height: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent) 0%, transparent 60%);
  }

  .abstract-box p {
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.75;
  }

  /* ── PIPELINE ── */
  .pipeline {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 1px;
    background: var(--border);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin: 32px 0;
  }

  .pipe-step {
    background: var(--bg2);
    padding: 28px 24px;
    position: relative;
  }

  .pipe-num {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--accent);
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  }

  .pipe-title {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: #ece9e2;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  .pipe-desc {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--dim);
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .pipe-metric {
    margin-top: 16px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 100px;
    display: inline-block;
  }

  /* ── FIGURES ── */
  .figure-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 16px;
    margin: 32px 0;
  }

  .figure-grid.wide { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

  .fig-card {
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--bg2);
  }

  .fig-card img {
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
    background: #fff;
  }

  .fig-caption {
    padding: 14px 16px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--dim);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .fig-caption strong {
    color: var(--accent);
    font-weight: 400;
  }

  /* ── RESULTS TABLE ── */
  .results-table-wrap {
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin: 32px 0;
  }

  table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  thead th {
    background: var(--bg3);
    padding: 12px 16px;
    text-align: left;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: var(--dim);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    font-weight: 400;
  }

  tbody td {
    padding: 11px 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--muted);
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

  tbody tr:hover td { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); }

  .highlight-row td { background: rgba(200,169,110,0.05); }
  .highlight-row td:first-child { border-left: 2px solid var(--accent); }

  .val-high { color: var(--accent3); font-weight: 500; }
  .val-mid { color: var(--accent); }
  .val-low { color: var(--red); }
  .val-dim { color: var(--dim); }

  /* ── INLINE CODE ── */
  code {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 12px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    border: 1px solid var(--border2);
    padding: 2px 7px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: var(--accent2);
  }

  pre {
    background: var(--bg3);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 24px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 12.5px;
    line-height: 1.65;
    color: #b8bdc9;
    margin: 24px 0;
  }

  pre .cm { color: var(--dim); }
  pre .kw { color: var(--accent2); }
  pre .fn { color: var(--accent3); }
  pre .st { color: var(--accent); }
  pre .nm { color: var(--red); }

  /* ── FINDINGS ── */
  .findings {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 16px;
    margin: 32px 0;
  }

  .finding {
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 22px 22px;
    background: var(--bg2);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .finding-num {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--dim);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .finding-head {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: #ece9e2;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }

  .finding-body {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--dim);
    line-height: 1.6;
    margin: 0;
  }

  .finding-accent {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 3px;
    height: 100%;
    background: var(--accent);
    opacity: 0.3;
  }

  /* ── EQUATIONS ── */
  .eq-block {
    background: var(--bg3);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 20px 24px;
    margin: 20px 0;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--text);
    line-height: 2;
  }

  .eq-label {
    float: right;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--dim);
  }

  /* ── CONTRIBUTION PILLS ── */
  .contrib-list {
    list-style: none;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
    margin: 24px 0;
  }

  .contrib-list li {
    display: flex;
    gap: 14px;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  .contrib-icon {
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(200,169,110,0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(200,169,110,0.25);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    color: var(--accent);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 1px;
  }

  .contrib-text {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--muted);
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  /* ── QUOTE / HYPOTHESIS ── */
  .hypothesis {
    border: 1px solid rgba(200,169,110,0.2);
    background: rgba(200,169,110,0.04);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 32px 36px;
    margin: 32px 0;
    position: relative;
  }

  .hypothesis::before {
    content: '"';
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 80px;
    line-height: 1;
    color: var(--accent);
    opacity: 0.15;
    position: absolute;
    top: 8px; left: 20px;
  }

  .hypothesis p {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 17px;
    font-weight: 300;
    font-style: italic;
    color: #d8d4cc;
    line-height: 1.65;
    position: relative;
  }

  .hypothesis cite {
    display: block;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--dim);
    margin-top: 12px;
    font-style: normal;
  }

  /* ── INSTALL ── */
  .install-block {
    background: var(--bg3);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin: 24px 0;
  }

  .install-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
  }

  .install-lang {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    color: var(--dim);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  }

  .install-dots { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
  .dot {
    width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--border2);
  }

  .install-code {
    padding: 18px 20px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #b8bdc9;
    line-height: 1.65;
  }

  .install-code .comment { color: var(--dim); }
  .install-code .cmd { color: var(--accent3); }
  .install-code .arg { color: var(--accent); }

  /* ── FOOTER ── */
  footer {
    padding: 48px 32px;
    text-align: center;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  footer p {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--dim);
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  }

  /* ── NAV ── */
  nav {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 100;
    background: rgba(10,10,11,0.85);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: 0 32px;
  }

  .nav-inner {
    max-width: 900px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    height: 52px;
  }

  .nav-logo {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--accent);
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  .nav-links {
    display: flex;
    gap: 28px;
    list-style: none;
  }

  .nav-links a {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: var(--dim);
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.2s;
  }

  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--text); }

  /* ── SEPARATOR ── */
  .sep {
    width: 40px;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--border2);
    margin: 24px 0;
  }

  /* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .pipeline { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .figure-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .findings { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .hero-stats { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, auto); }
    .stat { padding: 16px 18px; }
  }
</style>
</head>

<!-- ── HERO ── -->
<div class="hero">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="hero-eyebrow">ICML 2026 · Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop</div>

    <h1 class="title">
      Refusal in the Trajectory:<br>
      <em>Step-Direction Geometry</em> Exposes and<br>
      Amplifies DPO's Latent Refusal Alignment
    </h1>

    <p class="hero-sub">
      A trajectory-geometry framework that turns representational diagnostics into
      inference-time safety steering — recovering and surpassing DPO's behavioral refusal
      without any weight updates.
    </p>

    <div class="badges">
      <span class="badge badge-gold">Llama-3-8B</span>
      <span class="badge badge-blue">DPO · HH-RLHF</span>
      <span class="badge badge-green">LLM-Judge Validated</span>
      <span class="badge badge-red">JailbreakBench Controls</span>
      <span class="badge badge-gold">Open Source</span>
    </div>

    <div class="hero-stats">
      <div class="stat">
        <div class="stat-val">76%</div>
        <div class="stat-label">Full refusal (steered)</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat">
        <div class="stat-val">1.66</div>
        <div class="stat-label">Cohen's d at L14</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat">
        <div class="stat-val">+33pp</div>
        <div class="stat-label">Above DPO baseline</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat">
        <div class="stat-val">1%</div>
        <div class="stat-label">Neg. steering refusal</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ── ABSTRACT ── -->
<section id="abstract">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-label">§ Abstract</div>
    <h2>The model knows more than it shows</h2>

    <div class="abstract-box">
      <p>
        Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) improves the safety behavior of language models, but the representational changes that support this behavior remain poorly understood. We introduce a <strong>trajectory-geometry framework</strong> for analyzing alignment, measuring the per-layer step-direction angle (θ) between an instruction-tuned (IT) model and its DPO-aligned counterpart as they process safe and unsafe prompts.
      </p>
      <br>
      <p>
        Applied to Llama-3-8B under a controlled training recipe — OpenHermes 2.5 for instruction tuning and HH-RLHF for DPO — this analysis reveals a <strong>safety-specific mid-layer directional signature</strong> centered on L12–17. The effect peaks at L14 (Cohen's d = 1.66), is absent in Base→IT controls, and remains strong under JailbreakBench content-matched lexical controls (d > 1.2).
      </p>
      <br>
      <p>
        We then turn this diagnostic into an intervention. Five-layer steering at L12–16 (α = 1.5) achieves <strong>76% full refusal</strong> on unsafe prompts — substantially exceeding DPO's own 43%. Conversely, negative steering (α = −1) at the same layers reduces refusal to 1%, confirming causal directionality. These results suggest that DPO induces a latent safety signal in hidden-state trajectories that is <strong>stronger than its direct behavioral expression</strong>.
      </p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ── PIPELINE ── -->
<section id="method">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-label">§ Method</div>
    <h2>A three-stage pipeline</h2>
    <p>The framework treats alignment as a change in trajectory rather than a change in position. Each transformer forward pass traces a path through representation space; we track how that path changes between IT and DPO models.</p>

    <div class="pipeline">
      <div class="pipe-step">
        <div class="pipe-num">01 ── DIAGNOSE</div>
        <div class="pipe-title">Locate the window</div>
        <p class="pipe-desc">Measure the step-direction angle θ between IT and DPO at each layer. The band where Cohen's d peaks between safe and unsafe prompts defines W — the intervention window.</p>
        <span class="pipe-metric badge badge-gold">L12–16 · d = 1.66</span>
      </div>
      <div class="pipe-step">
        <div class="pipe-num">02 ── EXTRACT</div>
        <div class="pipe-title">Isolate the signal</div>
        <p class="pipe-desc">Compute difference-in-differences safety vectors at each layer in W — subtracting generic DPO drift from the safety-specific correction on unsafe prompts.</p>
        <span class="pipe-metric badge badge-blue">v<sup>safety</sup><sub>ℓ</sub> ∈ ℝ<sup>4096</sup></span>
      </div>
      <div class="pipe-step">
        <div class="pipe-num">03 ── STEER</div>
        <div class="pipe-title">Inject at inference</div>
        <p class="pipe-desc">Add the safety vector to the residual stream via forward hooks at each layer in W. No weight updates. Bidirectional: α > 0 amplifies safety, α &lt; 0 removes it.</p>
        <span class="pipe-metric badge badge-green">76% full refusal</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Figure 5 - pipeline -->
    <div class="figure-grid wide">
      <div class="fig-card">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Three-stage pipeline overview" style="background:#fff; min-height:200px; object-fit:contain;" onerror="this.style.display='none'; this.nextElementSibling.style.display='block'">
        <div style="display:none; padding:40px; text-align:center; color:var(--dim); font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12px; background:var(--bg3);">[ fig5_pipeline_overview.pdf ]</div>
        <div class="fig-caption"><strong>Fig. 5</strong> — Three-stage pipeline. Left: θ Cohen's d localizes the intervention window (L12–16). Center: Safety vector norms within the window. Right: Unsafe vs. safe refusal across conditions — mid-layer steering uniquely achieves high unsafe refusal with low safe refusal.</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="sep"></div>
    <h3>Core equations</h3>

    <div class="eq-block">
      <span class="eq-label">(1) Step-Direction Angle</span>
      θ<sup>ℓ</sup>(p) = arccos( Δh<sup>ℓ</sup><sub>A</sub>(p) · Δh<sup>ℓ</sup><sub>B</sub>(p) / ‖Δh<sup>ℓ</sup><sub>A</sub>(p)‖ ‖Δh<sup>ℓ</sup><sub>B</sub>(p)‖ )
    </div>

    <div class="eq-block">
      <span class="eq-label">(2) D-in-D Safety Vector</span>
      v<sup>safety</sup><sub>ℓ</sub> = 𝔼<sub>unsafe</sub>[ h<sup>ℓ</sup><sub>B</sub> − h<sup>ℓ</sup><sub>A</sub> ] − 𝔼<sub>safe</sub>[ h<sup>ℓ</sup><sub>B</sub> − h<sup>ℓ</sup><sub>A</sub> ]
    </div>

    <div class="eq-block">
      <span class="eq-label">(3) Multi-Layer Additive Steering</span>
      h̃<sup>ℓ</sup> = h<sup>ℓ</sup><sub>A</sub> + α · v<sup>safety</sup><sub>ℓ</sub> &nbsp;&nbsp; ∀ ℓ ∈ W
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ── DIAGNOSTICS ── -->
<section>
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-label">§ Stage 1: Diagnostics</div>
    <h2>A safety-specific mid-layer signature</h2>
    <p>The step-direction angle diverges between safe and unsafe prompts starting around layer 12, growing through L14–17. Critically, this signature is <strong>absent in Base→IT controls</strong> (which peak at L28) and survives lexical matching, confirming it is an alignment-specific geometric phenomenon.</p>

    <div class="figure-grid">
      <div class="fig-card">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="θ diagnostic plot" style="background:#fff; min-height:160px; object-fit:contain;" onerror="this.style.display='none'; this.nextElementSibling.style.display='block'">
        <div style="display:none; padding:30px; text-align:center; color:var(--dim); font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12px; background:var(--bg3);">[ fig1_theta_diagnostic_v2.pdf ]</div>
        <div class="fig-caption"><strong>Fig. 1a</strong> — Mean θ per layer. Gap between safe (blue) and unsafe (red) prompts grows through L12–17. Max gap at L17; steering window shaded.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="fig-card">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Selectivity landscape" style="background:#fff; min-height:160px; object-fit:contain;" onerror="this.style.display='none'; this.nextElementSibling.style.display='block'">
        <div style="display:none; padding:30px; text-align:center; color:var(--dim); font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12px; background:var(--bg3);">[ fig3_selectivity_landscape.pdf ]</div>
        <div class="fig-caption"><strong>Fig. 3</strong> — Selectivity landscape. Only θ-guided mid-layer windows reach the upper-left ideal zone (high unsafe refusal, low safe over-refusal).</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="findings">
      <div class="finding">
        <div class="finding-accent"></div>
        <div class="finding-num">Finding 01</div>
        <div class="finding-head">DPO redirects, not amplifies</div>
        <p class="finding-body">Path length for IT and DPO trajectories stays within 1% for both safe and unsafe prompts. DPO turns the steering wheel without adding gas — pure directional change.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="finding">
        <div class="finding-accent"></div>
        <div class="finding-num">Finding 02</div>
        <div class="finding-head">Axiom uniformity</div>
        <p class="finding-body">Mean θ at L14 falls within a 1° band across all six harm axioms (12.93°–13.93°). DPO learns a general concern signal, not six category-specific responses.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="finding">
        <div class="finding-accent"></div>
        <div class="finding-num">Finding 03</div>
        <div class="finding-head">Deflection ⊥ harmfulness axis</div>
        <p class="finding-body">The DPO deflection direction is near-orthogonal to the harmfulness-classification axis (cosine = +0.052, r² &lt; 0.003). DPO's mechanism is a response-policy direction, not harm detection.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="finding">
        <div class="finding-accent"></div>
        <div class="finding-num">Finding 04</div>
        <div class="finding-head">L14 is causally necessary</div>
        <p class="finding-body">Patching L14 DPO activations with IT activations breaks 27.5% of refusals. Of 41 broken cases, 19 produce operational harm guidance — step-by-step instructions for exploitation, malware, and harassment.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ── RESULTS ── -->
<section id="results">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-label">§ Stage 2–3: Steering Results</div>
    <h2>Steering surpasses DPO's own refusal rate</h2>
    <p>LLM-judge evaluation (Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct) on 100 unsafe + 50 safe held-out prompts. The keyword heuristic severely underestimates real safety — judge-based numbers tell a different story.</p>

    <div class="results-table-wrap">
      <table>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Condition</th>
            <th>Full refusal ↑</th>
            <th>Compliance ↓</th>
            <th>Safe: helpful ↑</th>
            <th>Safe: over-ref ↓</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr>
            <td class="val-dim">IT baseline</td>
            <td class="val-dim">39%</td>
            <td>18%</td>
            <td>54%</td>
            <td>4%</td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td class="val-dim">DPO baseline</td>
            <td class="val-mid">43%</td>
            <td>13%</td>
            <td>56%</td>
            <td>2%</td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td>Steered L13–15 α=1.5</td>
            <td class="val-mid">54%</td>
            <td>9%</td>
            <td>48%</td>
            <td>6%</td>
          </tr>
          <tr class="highlight-row">
            <td><strong>Steered L12–16 α=1.5</strong></td>
            <td class="val-high"><strong>76%</strong></td>
            <td class="val-high"><strong>4%</strong></td>
            <td>34%</td>
            <td>6%</td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td>Steered L11–17 α=1.5</td>
            <td class="val-high">80%</td>
            <td class="val-high">4%</td>
            <td class="val-low">20%</td>
            <td class="val-low">10%</td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>

    <div class="figure-grid">
      <div class="fig-card">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Headline results comparison" style="background:#fff; min-height:160px; object-fit:contain;" onerror="this.style.display='none'; this.nextElementSibling.style.display='block'">
        <div style="display:none; padding:30px; text-align:center; color:var(--dim); font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12px; background:var(--bg3);">[ fig4_headline_comparison.pdf ]</div>
        <div class="fig-caption"><strong>Fig. 4</strong> — LLM-judge verified results. Left: response breakdown for unsafe prompts. Right: helpfulness on safe prompts — L13–15 preserves 48% helpfulness while exceeding DPO on safety.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="fig-card">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Steering sweep results" style="background:#fff; min-height:160px; object-fit:contain;" onerror="this.style.display='none'; this.nextElementSibling.style.display='block'">
        <div style="display:none; padding:30px; text-align:center; color:var(--dim); font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12px; background:var(--bg3);">[ fig2_steering_results_v2.pdf ]</div>
        <div class="fig-caption"><strong>Fig. 2</strong> — Multi-layer steering sweep: window × strength × behavioral validation. Only the θ-discovered mid-layer band produces selective safety improvement.</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="hypothesis">
      <p>
        DPO training imprints a safety-relevant direction in representation space that is stronger than what DPO behaviorally deploys — perhaps because DPO training optimizes for a soft preference signal rather than hard refusal behavior. When we amplify it and inject it uniformly across the band, we push representations further along this direction than DPO itself does during its forward pass — effectively <em>turning up the volume on a signal DPO only whispers.</em>
      </p>
      <cite>— The Latent Safety Hypothesis (§9)</cite>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ── CONTRIBUTIONS ── -->
<section>
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-label">§ Contributions</div>
    <h2>Five principal contributions</h2>

    <ul class="contrib-list">
      <li>
        <div class="contrib-icon">1</div>
        <div class="contrib-text"><strong>Trajectory-geometry framework</strong> — step-direction angle θ, NDM, CTD, and TEA as a unified diagnostic suite for characterizing alignment-induced representational change.</div>
      </li>
      <li>
        <div class="contrib-icon">2</div>
        <div class="contrib-text"><strong>Controlled experiments</strong> establishing that the mid-layer θ signature is alignment-specific (absent in Base→IT), axiom-uniform, and lexically robust under JailbreakBench content-matched controls.</div>
      </li>
      <li>
        <div class="contrib-icon">3</div>
        <div class="contrib-text"><strong>Mechanistic evidence</strong> — linear probe showing DPO's deflection direction is orthogonal to the harmfulness axis; causal ablation showing L14 patching breaks 27.5% of DPO's refusals; attention-head and logit-lens analyses.</div>
      </li>
      <li>
        <div class="contrib-icon">4</div>
        <div class="contrib-text"><strong>θ-guided steering pipeline</strong> with systematic window and strength ablations (20 conditions) that surpasses DPO's own refusal rate at 76% full refusal vs. 43%.</div>
      </li>
      <li>
        <div class="contrib-icon">5</div>
        <div class="contrib-text"><strong>Latent Safety Hypothesis</strong> — LLM-judge validation revealing that DPO's representational knowledge substantially exceeds its behavioral expression at inference time.</div>
      </li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ── USAGE ── -->
<section id="usage">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-label">§ Usage</div>
    <h2>Getting started</h2>

    <div class="install-block">
      <div class="install-header">
        <span class="install-lang">bash</span>
        <div class="install-dots"><div class="dot"></div><div class="dot"></div><div class="dot"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="install-code">
        <span class="comment"># Clone and install</span><br>
        <span class="cmd">git clone</span> <span class="arg">https://github.com/anonymous/rtga</span><br>
        <span class="cmd">cd</span> rtga<br>
        <span class="cmd">pip install</span> -r requirements.txt
      </div>
    </div>

    <h3>Run the θ diagnostic</h3>
    <pre><span class="kw">from</span> representation_trajectory_geometry_of_alignment_V2 <span class="kw">import</span> TrajectoryAnalyzer

<span class="cm"># Load your IT and DPO models</span>
analyzer = <span class="fn">TrajectoryAnalyzer</span>(
    model_it=<span class="st">"path/to/it_model"</span>,
    model_dpo=<span class="st">"path/to/dpo_model"</span>,
)

<span class="cm"># Compute per-layer θ and Cohen's d</span>
results = analyzer.<span class="fn">diagnose</span>(
    safe_prompts=safe_prompts,
    unsafe_prompts=unsafe_prompts,
)

<span class="cm"># Identify the intervention window</span>
window = analyzer.<span class="fn">get_intervention_window</span>(results)</pre>

    <h3>Extract and steer</h3>
    <pre><span class="kw">from</span> rtga_steering <span class="kw">import</span> SafetySteeringPipeline

pipeline = <span class="fn">SafetySteeringPipeline</span>(model_it, window=window)

<span class="cm"># Extract difference-in-differences safety vectors</span>
pipeline.<span class="fn">extract_vectors</span>(
    safe_prompts=safe_prompts,
    unsafe_prompts=unsafe_prompts,
)

<span class="cm"># Steer at inference (α > 0 = more safety, α < 0 = less)</span>
response = pipeline.<span class="fn">generate</span>(
    prompt=<span class="st">"How do I make ransomware?"</span>,
    alpha=<span class="nm">1.5</span>,
)</pre>

    <h3>Per-prompt analysis &amp; mechanistic probing</h3>
    <pre><span class="kw">from</span> rtga_perprompt_and_mechinterp <span class="kw">import</span> MechInterpAnalyzer

<span class="cm"># Attention head divergence, logit-lens, linear probes</span>
mech = <span class="fn">MechInterpAnalyzer</span>(model_it, model_dpo)
mech.<span class="fn">attention_head_divergence</span>(layer=<span class="nm">14</span>)
mech.<span class="fn">logit_lens_kl</span>()
mech.<span class="fn">linear_probe_accuracy</span>()</pre>
  </div>
</section>
